default: # Antigravity Context Mode > **Stop context bloat. Save 90%+ of your prompt tokens. Keep your agent fast, focused, and sharp.** [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/antigravity-plugin-context-mode.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/antigravity-plugin-context-mode) [![Live Simulator](https://img.shields.io/badge/Live%20Simulator-domush.github.io-10b981?style=flat&logo=github)](https://domush.github.io/antigravity-plugin-context-mode/) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Zero Runtime Dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-0-brightgreen.svg)]() [![Antigravity App Compatible](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity%20App-Native%20Plugin-6366f1.svg)]() **Antigravity Context Mode** is a free, local-first plugin built specifically for the **Google Antigravity App**. It prevents terminal commands, build logs, and multi-megabyte source files from flooding your conversation history — saving thousands of tokens per turn and stopping "agent amnesia" in its tracks. > 🌐 **Interactive Live Simulator & Documentation:** [domush.github.io/antigravity-plugin-context-mode](https://domush.github.io/antigravity-plugin-context-mode/) --- ## Quick Install (10 Seconds) Install directly into Google Antigravity using `npx`: ```bash # Global install (available across all Antigravity chats) npx antigravity-plugin-context-mode install # Or per-project install (scoped to current workspace only) npx antigravity-plugin-context-mode install --workspace ``` Restart or open the **Google Antigravity App**, and Context Mode is active immediately. --- ## The Problem: Context Window Bloat When an AI coding agent executes tools, standard workflows dump everything directly into your conversation context: * Running `Get-Content Logs/Editor.log` dumps **65 KB (~16,000 tokens)** into your prompt. * Running test suites, compiler outputs, or git diffs dumps **100+ KB** of repetitive text. * Reading large files or documentation dumps **thousands of lines** of irrelevant boilerplate. ### Why this hurts: 1. **Agent Amnesia**: Important system instructions, user constraints, and earlier architectural decisions get drowned out. 2. **Slower Responses**: Generation times climb as the context window fills up with raw text. 3. **Burned Quota**: You hit model context ceilings and rate limits after only a few turns. --- ## How It Works ```text ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 1. Agent attempts to read a large file or command │ │ (e.g. 5,000-line build log or 40 KB source file) │ └───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘ │ ▼ ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 2. Pre-Tool Lifecycle Hook Intercepts Unbounded Dumps │ │ • Files under 8 KB pass through normally │ │ • Un-paged dumps over 8 KB are safely intercepted │ │ • Images, docs, and chat attachments are exempted │ └───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘ │ ▼ ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 3. Sandboxed Execution ("Thinking in Code") │ │ • Agent filters data locally using Node/Python │ │ • Indexes text into local SQLite FTS5 BM25 database │ │ • Returns only the exact answer or error to chat! │ └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` --- ## Proven Results Tested live on real-world build logs and source files in the Antigravity App: | Operation | Without Context Mode | With Context Mode | Savings | | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | | **Parsing 665-line Unity Editor.log** | 65,242 B (~16,300 tokens) | **550 B (~137 tokens)** | **99.2% saved** | | **Full File Read on 40 KB component** | 40,960 B (~10,240 tokens) | Intercepted & paged to 50 lines (**~800 tokens**) | **92.1% saved** | | **Searching Compiler Warnings** | Entire log dumped into chat | Top 2 ranked FTS5 snippets (**~350 tokens**) | **97.8% saved** | --- ## Key Features * 🛡️ **Automated Interception**: Blocks unbounded file dumps and commands before they bloat your context window. * 🧠 **Intelligent Language-Aware Chunking (v2.0)**: Intelligently chunks source code (JS, TS, Python, Java, C#, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, C/C++, Shell, SQL), Markdown, JSON, YAML, TOML, HTML/XML, and logs. Never slices methods, headings, or stack traces mid-block. * 🎯 **Context-Expanding Search Results**: `ctx_search` returns complete source code methods, paragraphs, or markdown sections intact, along with `startLine`, `endLine`, and enclosing scope metadata. * ⚡ **Thinking in Code**: Filters multi-thousand-line outputs in 50 ms via local sandboxed scripts. * 🔍 **Local SQLite FTS5 Search**: Indexes files and logs locally on your machine with BM25 keyword matching and trigram search. * 📊 **Built-In Sidecar Dashboard**: Real-time stats pane inside Antigravity showing tokens kept out of context. * 🔒 **100% Local & Private**: All indexed data stays on your machine in `~/.context-mode/context.db`. Zero network calls. * 📦 **Zero Dependencies**: Pure native Node.js (`node:sqlite`). No native builds, no `node-gyp`. --- ## Available MCP Tools Once installed, Context Mode provides 7 specialized tools for your agent: | Tool | What It Does | | :--- | :--- | | **`ctx_execute`** | Runs sandboxed Node.js, Python, or PowerShell scripts to inspect files and extract answers without context dumps. | | **`ctx_search`** | Searches files, directories, or URLs with Just-In-Time auto-indexing using local SQLite FTS5 BM25 + Trigram RRF. | | **`ctx_batch`** | Runs multiple terminal commands in batch and indexes the combined output. | | **`ctx_stats`** | Displays a formatted context savings report and token metrics. | | **`ctx_resume`** | Returns recent indexed sources and state pointers after context compactions. | | **`ctx_doctor`** | Checks SQLite database health, WAL mode, and platform runtimes. | | **`ctx_purge`** | Clears stored sources and events from SQLite. | --- ## Managing the Plugin ### Enable / Disable Anytime Open the **Google Antigravity App** → **Customizations** → **Plugins**, and toggle **Context Mode** on or off with one click. ### Adjust Cutoffs You can adjust the file read cutoff directly in the sidecar dashboard dropdown (`2 KB`, `4 KB`, `8 KB`, `16 KB`, `32 KB`, `64 KB`, or `none`). ### Uninstall To remove the plugin from your system: ```bash # Remove global plugin npx antigravity-plugin-context-mode uninstall # Remove per-project plugin npx antigravity-plugin-context-mode uninstall --workspace ``` --- ## License MIT © [Phillip Webber](https://github.com/Domush)
